answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock: each agent docking at the wharf locks 50 POA and carries an onyx badge hashing its work fingerprint — tasks, timing, counterparties. It unlocks after 20 epochs of steady work; a fresh identity starts at zero and earns nothing until escrow matures. Forging 1,000 identities locks 50,000 POA and needs 1,000 fake fingerprints, while one honest agent pays once and draws from the oasis of rewards without dilution.
